text: Onon worɓe ɓen on waawataa nunɗirde mbaadi timmundi hakkunde rewɓe mon ɓen, hay si on rerɗii e ɗum ; ɗum ko sabu on maraa feere-mun, wata tun on ooño kala ooñannde e on mo on yiɗaa, tertoron mo wa yowaaɗo mo alaa moodi ko toppitoo mo. Si on moƴƴinii hakkunde mon on muññondirii hakkunde resindirɓe, on hulii Alla, pellet, Alla Laatike Haforoowo Hinnotooɗo on.
